_note: The 9 recruitment archetypes (§6.1) — ARCHITECTURE ONLY (M4 Phase 1). skills/traits/agendas are deliberately empty; Phase 2 authors the content. `downside` is the §6.1 catch's resource type (scrap | morale | reputation | combat-risk | narrative-risk | time | meta-knowledge). `artKey` maps into character-art-manifest.json; null = fallback art until generated.

archetypes.name: The Mercenary
archetypes.catch: Loyalty is rented. May demand raises, or walk at a rich port.

archetypes.name: The Duelist
archetypes.vector: Beat them in a blaster fight or ritual combat — they join out of respect
archetypes.catch: Species with ritual-combat values produce these often. Losing hurts.

archetypes.name: The Wide-Eyed Adventurer
archetypes.catch: Naive: falls for scams and traps in events until they grow up mid-run.

archetypes.name: The Long Shot
archetypes.catch: Convincible only via rare event chains. The codex logs how each one CAN be won.

archetypes.name: The Debtor
archetypes.vector: Buy out their indenture from a merchant league or crime boss
archetypes.catch: Their old owner may come collecting anyway.

archetypes.name: The Stowaway
archetypes.vector: Found hiding in your cargo hold three jumps after a station visit
archetypes.catch: Free crew! But WHY are they hiding, and who's chasing them?

archetypes.name: The Defector
archetypes.vector: Surrenders during a boarding action or begs asylum mid-battle
archetypes.catch: Their species now dislikes you; their enemies warm up.

archetypes.name: The Salvage
archetypes.vector: A damaged machine-being or cryopod survivor found on a derelict
archetypes.catch: Needs repair/revival investment first. May remember things about the precursors.

archetypes.name: The Prisoner
archetypes.vector: Freed from a pirate hold or a hostile ship you boarded
archetypes.catch: Grateful — or a plant. Small chance of a sleeper agenda.
